waivers.scope: .claude/skills/code-map/scripts/code_index/code_index.py — the flat imports compiled_index, graph_metrics, map_render, py_index, ts_index
waivers.reason: False positive on vendored harness code. All five names are sibling modules in the same directory (compiled_index.py, graph_metrics.py, map_render.py, py_index.py, ts_index.py all exist next to code_index.py). code_index.py runs as a standalone script with its own directory on sys.path, so the imports are flat rather than relative — the sensor reads them as unresolvable third-party pypi packages. Verified by directory listing before waiving. Not fixed by rewriting to relative imports, because that would break standalone execution of a harness control-plane script this project does not own.

waivers.scope: The 26 ready stories outside Group A (E15-S1, E9-S1, E11-S1) — every other story in specs/stories/ still has '### Operations' as '- pending'.
waivers.reason: generation-contract --mode implementable validates ALL ready stories unconditionally once any production source is staged, not just the current group's. This dispatch's mandate was limited to Group A (E15-S1/E9-S1/E11-S1) per generator.md Rule 1.5 — filling Operations for the other 26 stories (Groups B-M) requires design/approach context this dispatch does not own and is out of scope for it. Group A's own 3 stories are filled and pass this same check in isolation (validate-generation-contract.js --mode implementable --story <id> exit 0 for all three). This waiver unblocks landing Group A's production code; it does not claim the other 26 stories are implementable yet. Flagged to the orchestrator: this gate will re-block every subsequent group's /implement run the same way until either all story Operations are filled ahead of implementation, or a future group's generator fills its own group's Operations the same way this one did. Short expiry so it must be revisited, not left standing.
